test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following criteria is a primary requirement for a beach or marina to receive the international Blue Flag certification?

options.text: Presence of luxury resorts and high-end tourism facilities.
Exclusive access for private members or residents.
High standards of water quality, environmental management, safety, and services.
Location within a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

solution:
The correct answer is __**High standards of water quality, environmental management, safety, and services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Blue Flag certification** is an international eco-label awarded to beaches and marinas that meet stringent criteria concerning **environmental management, water quality, safety, and services**.
 
• To qualify for this certification, locations must ensure **excellent water quality standards**, including parameters like bacterial contamination levels and chemical pollutants.
 
• There must be strong adherence to **environmental education and information programs** aimed at creating awareness about sustainable practices among visitors.
 
• The certification requires adequate **safety measures**, including lifeguard services, first aid facilities, and well-marked swimming zones to ensure public safety.
 
• Proper facilities, including clean toilets, waste disposal systems, and disabled access, are mandatory to ensure a high standard of visitor services. **Hence, this option is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Blue Flag Certification:**

 
 
• The Blue Flag program was initiated by the **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE)** in **1985** and is recognized globally for promoting sustainable development in beach and marina areas.
 
• Countries with Blue Flag certified beaches include **Spain, France, Greece, South Africa, India, and others**.
 
• The certification is valid for **one year**, and locations must continuously meet the criteria to retain their status.
 
• India's first Blue Flag certified beaches include **Chandrabhaga Beach** in Odisha and **Kappad Beach** in Kerala.
 
• This program helps enhance tourism, promote sustainable practices, and protect the marine ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Key Criteria for Blue Flag Certification:**
 
 
• **Water Quality:** Regular monitoring of water for pollutants, ensuring compliance with international standards.
 
• **Environmental Education:** Displaying environmental information and conducting educational activities for visitors.
 
• **Safety:** Ensuring proper lifeguard services, first aid facilities, and safety measures for visitors.
 
• **Waste Management:** Establishing clean waste disposal systems and maintaining cleanliness.
 
• **Aesthetics:** Maintaining the natural beauty and ecological balance of the area.
 
 
 
• **Non-Criteria Points:**
 
 
• **Presence of luxury resorts:** While luxury resorts may attract tourists, they are not a requirement for Blue Flag certification.
 
• **Exclusive access for private members:** This exclusivity is not a criterion for certification as Blue Flag beaches are meant to be accessible to all.
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites:** Being located in a UNESCO site is unrelated to Blue Flag certification criteria.
 
 
 
• **Global Importance:**
 
 
• There are over **5,000 Blue Flag beaches and marinas** worldwide, spread across **48 countries**.
 
• These certifications play a crucial role in boosting eco-tourism and improving local economies.
 
• The program promotes **conservation efforts** and encourages sustainable practices globally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE):**

 
 
• The **FEE** is a non-governmental organization based in Denmark that oversees programs like Blue Flag, Eco-Schools, and Green Key.
 
• The Blue Flag program aims to **promote sustainable development** by adhering to strict environmental, educational, and safety criteria.
 
 
 
• **India’s Efforts:**
 
 
• The **Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** launched the BEAMS program under the ICZM project to help achieve Blue Flag certification.
 
• India has **12 Blue Flag certified beaches** as of **2023**, showcasing its commitment to environmental conservation and sustainable tourism.
 
• Examples include beaches like **Radhanagar Beach (Andaman and Nicobar Islands)**, **Golden Beach (Odisha)**, and **Padubidri Beach (Karnataka)**.
